nps_2020.name: National Police Service Annual Crime Report 2020, Appendix 10: Offences per County for the Year 2020 (HOMICIDE column)

problems: IMPORTANT: Kenya's police 'Homicide' category is NOT intentional homicide only. The reports' national breakdown of Homicide = a) Murder, b) Manslaughter, c) Infanticide, d) Procuring abortion, e) Concealing birth, f) Suicide, g) Causing death by dangerous driving. By county only the combined Homicide column is published; e.g. 2020 national: murder 2,025 of 3,111 homicide. Only extracted from PDFs with pdftotext -layout and checked against totals. 2016 report's county table (Appendix 10) was NOT used: its row labels are scrambled (e.g. the row labelled KIAMBU carries Meru's total 5,117 and the row labelled SIAYA carries Nairobi's 4,954), so county attribution is unreliable. 2011 report is by former province (pre-county), not used. 2021, 2022 and 2023 reports have their county tables as images; OCR (tesseract) was tried on 2021 and was not reliable enough, so not used. Kenya police website serves a certificate chain ending in the Comodo 'AAA Certificate Services' root; that public root (sha256 D7:A7:A0:FB...) was added to the CA file to download.
